sourceProvenance.note: Workspace .tmp_room_model.glb is the same file as the phone's Hausen_Room_3.glb (size and SHA-256 match). It is the model used by the Stage 0 A0-A7 performance rows.

classification.animatedNodePolicy: Exclude every animated target and all descendants.
classification.transparentMaterialPolicy: Exclude meshes using transmission or non-opaque alpha materials.
classification.exclusionReason: Shadow proxy candidates keep the same conservative policy: no animated subtree, no transparent/transmissive material.
